notes.title: A note about controllers and quitting...
notes.content:
As you may notice, Assault Suit Leynos is listed as only having Partial Controller Support. This is due to a minor issue that we are already aware of:

• Currently, there is no Quit Game option on the title screen. To exit the game back to desktop/the Steam client, players must press the ESC key on the keyboard instead (twice if playing in Full Screen mode).

We are currently working hard to upgrade Assault Suit Leynos to Full Controller Support by correcting this issue and should be able to report progress on this soon. Thank you for your patience and understanding!

Also regarding controller support, the game supports official Xbox 360 pads from first boot and can played with one immediately. However, those using other pads may find their controller isn't initially detected by the game. To remedy this, use the arrow keys and Z on the keyboard to navigate from the title screen to Option > Config > Control and then choosing Default Xbox 360 Pad Set. This should then see your pad detected and it'll work from booting the game every time after this. This isn't a problem that prevents us from upgrading to Full Controller Support (since 360 pads work right away), but is still something that we will endeavour to address in the future.
